name: USDC (canonical testnet token, reference fungible v2)
summary: Reference token v1 plus allowances (approve / transfer_from), required by custody pools, routers and vaults.

functions.name: transfer
functions.description: Move `amount` from the caller's balance to `to`.

functions.name: mint_first
functions.description: One-time initial mint of the supply to `to`.
functions.access: Admin only, once. The admin is the first account to call the contract.

functions.name: approve
functions.description: Set (overwrite) how much `spender` may move from the caller with transfer_from.

functions.name: transfer_from
functions.description: Move `amount` from `from` to `to` using the caller's allowance; decrements the allowance.
functions.access: Any spender with allowance[from][caller] >= amount. Fails with no return data otherwise.

functions.name: allowance
functions.description: How much `spender` may still move from `owner`.
